hypothesis: The Fed original monthly G.17 ASCII releases may preserve 2011-2014 as-published semiconductor-related industrial production values missing from ALFRED selectable vintages. Before modeling, test whether old table code and post-2015 IPG3344S represent a coherent same-domain series.
source_authority: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, original dated G.17 statistical releases
selection: First available 2011, late 2014, and July 2015 discontinued-series transition observations chosen before fetching body; do not select dates by SOXX outcomes.
checks: HTTP 200 exact raw bytes/size/SHA and on-page G.17 release date/time
Find and preserve actual semiconductor/electronic component industry row, NAICS/source code and table context
Check whether 2011, 2014 and 2015 table definitions are semantically consistent with new 3344 series; no numerical splice if not
Archive original bytes to NAS with remote SHA and scoped restore
stop: A single old code/label mismatch or missing release value prevents whole-period feature calculation. Source-only result may recommend further bounded original-release reconstruction but cannot fit Stage1 or claim SOXX alpha.
